_purpose: v1.1 rebuild: deliverable wording for documented limitations whose unresolved[].why was rewritten by the V11 gap merge as a research log (process notes, fetch results, internal paths). Built from _research/validation/V11-gap-merge.md and the facts files; read by ccg_common._limitation_text. Label 'Not yet published' only where the item awaits a publication.

RQ-032.label: Not configured in this release
RQ-032.body: Whether Michigan allows electronic pay statements (MCL 408.479) is not established from an official source.

RQ-036.label: Not configured in this release
RQ-036.body: Michigan coverage thresholds are configured only for agricultural and domestic employment (`mi.sui.coverage.ag_domestic`); thresholds for other special populations are not established.

RQ-073.label: Not configured in this release
RQ-073.body: G.S. 95-25.6 sets the payday and the permitted pay periods but says nothing on the payment medium (cash, check, direct deposit, paycard); no North Carolina rule on payment method was located.

RQ-082.label: Not configured in this release
RQ-082.body: No North Carolina threshold is configured for special populations; UI employer coverage follows the federal FUTA employer definition (`nc.ui.registration`).

RQ-158.label: Not configured in this release
RQ-158.body: Florida rule chapter 73B-10 contains no separation-notice rule; chapter 73B-11 was not read, so the absence of an individual separation-notice duty is not established.

RQ-160.label: Not configured in this release
RQ-160.body: The 2026 Laws of Florida and the Department of Revenue tax information publications were not fully reviewed; only ch. 2026-52 is confirmed.

RQ-164.label: Not yet published
RQ-164.body: No 2026 act extending Article 6 beyond 2026-12-31 was located; the Georgia Department of Labor publishes its 2027 rate release in December 2026.

RQ-168.label: Not configured in this release
RQ-168.body: Georgia garnishment procedures were made uniform by Act 574 (SB 443, 2020), effective 2021-01-01; the text of 18-4-5 and the Department of Revenue wage-levy rules were not read.

RQ-169.label: Not configured in this release
RQ-169.body: 10-1-393.8 (Act 603, 2006) restricts the use and display of social security numbers; whether it covers pay statements is not established from the statute text on an official host.

RQ-199.label: Not configured in this release
RQ-199.body: No Illinois Department of Revenue statement on the treatment of HSA and s.125 amounts was read. 35 ILCS 5/203(b) starts from federal adjusted gross income and lists no HSA or s.125 addition, so the federal exclusions carry over; this is a reading of the statute, not a Department statement.

RQ-207.label: Not configured in this release
RQ-207.body: 2026 Illinois changes were reviewed in the Department of Revenue and Department of Labor news releases (bulletin texts not opened); the Department of Employment Security news releases were not reviewed.

RQ-264.label: Not yet published
RQ-264.body: The 2027 New York UI wage base (the state average annual wage, rounded up to the next hundred dollars) is expected in December 2026.

RQ-275.label: Not configured in this release
RQ-275.body: Ohio voting leave (ORC 3599.06) protects the employee but states no pay rule; the jury-duty (ORC 2313.19) and military-leave (ORC 5903.02) rules were not read.

RQ-278.label: Not configured in this release
RQ-278.body: The Ohio UI quarterly report channel and bulk-upload format were not located on official pages.

RQ-279.label: Not configured in this release
RQ-279.body: No individual UI separation-notice rule under OAC 4141 was located.

RQ-280.label: Not yet published
RQ-280.body: The 2027 Ohio withholding tables, UI rates and school-district changes are published later in the year.

RQ-282.label: Not configured in this release
RQ-282.body: ORC 718.04(D) leaves the resident credit to each municipal ordinance, so there is no statewide credit rate or limit; under ORC 718.03(A) the employer withholds for the work municipality and may withhold for the resident municipality on request. The collector of each municipality is not in the rate table.

RQ-342.label: Not yet published
RQ-342.body: The 2027 Texas Workforce Commission tax rates are set in November or December and are not yet published.

RQ-528.label: Not configured in this release
RQ-528.body: No federal notice gives the dates on which States go live with the revised income withholding order (gig-worker fields); States have an extension to reprogram, without a fixed date.

RQ-533.label: Not configured in this release
RQ-533.body: The successor-employer wage-base rule for related employers (26 U.S.C. 3121(a)(1) and 3306(b)(1)) is not established from an official source in this release.

RQ-580.label: Not yet published
RQ-580.body: The Texas Workforce Commission amendment to 40 TAC ch. 815 (new wage-record data elements) is proposed only and not adopted; the adoption date, the first mandatory quarter and the file layout are not published. The fields are not configured as mandatory.
